# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
# Shared vectors for validating a numeric GPY_* setting (non-negative decimal
# integer, else the default) and for the GPY_IPC_TIMEOUT_MS -> seconds
# conversion the IPC send path hands to `timeout`. The default here is 150,
# GPY_IPC_TIMEOUT_MS's. Read by:
#   - Fish:  __gpy_uint_or_default VALUE 150 -> `validated`
#            (tests/fish/uint_timeout_vectors.test.fish)
#   - Bash:  __gpy_ms_to_secs VALUE -> `secs`, which validates inline with the
#            same rule (tests/bash/uint_timeout_vectors.test.bash)
#   - Zsh:   __gpy_ms_to_secs VALUE -> `secs`
#            (tests/zsh/uint_timeout_vectors.test.zsh)
# `secs` is `validated` read as a DECIMAL millisecond count (a leading zero is
# not octal), printed as whole.milliseconds. Fish converts with an inline
# `math` at its use sites, so it has no `secs` helper to test.
# Format: one vector per line, tab-separated: value<TAB>validated<TAB>secs.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. The whole-column token \e
# means the EMPTY string; `value` is otherwise literal (spaces included).
# Every reader MUST fail if this file is missing or yields no vectors.
# Out of range on purpose: values past 2^63 overflow shell arithmetic
# differently in every shell and are not a meaningful timeout.
\e
